title: stack-kit driver registry
description: The kit's drivers/registry.json and a project's own registry (drivers.registry), validated together as one composed registry by `validate` (ADR-001 amendment 12). Roles are held to catalogs.roles in code.

roles.description: The roles the driver serves, first = a module's default role (catalogs.roles, or `any`)

runtime.description: Removed in 1.2.0: a command runs by its script's runtime (config/runtimes.json, manifest `runtimes`) or the command's own `runtime`. Read and ignored, with a notice

launch.description: The launch configuration as data, rendered per module by the kit's template grammar over the module's entry and {module}, {path}, {label}, {script}, {envFile} and each declared value (a former launch-kind string is no longer built: declare the data)

label.description: The launch's name, rendered (the module's debug.label wins; else the module id)

values.description: name -> its sources, the first that yields one wins (lib/vscode_gen.py): field (exists), driver, value, glob (single | as dotted under), file + capture

optional.description: Launch keys dropped when they have no value

runsOn.description: The CI runner a module of this driver builds on (default ubuntu-latest)

deployArgs.description: Former home of the release rung's args; read

container.description: How a release of the driver's modules runs (ADR-001 amendment 13): a recipe `template` (driver-relative, rendered per module: {toolchain.version|...}, {artifact}, {port}, {entry}), or a `static` image serving it; `port`, `artifact`, `entry`, `healthcheck`, `serve`

dev.description: Remote dev of the driver's modules: `image`, `command`, `build`, `port`, `caches` {name: mount}, `excludes`, `reactions` [{globs, do}]

generated.description: Directories the driver's tools generate (never drafted from, never synced)

audit.description: A dependency audit's facts, read by the driver's own audit command (a module's `audit` over it): scanner, image, args, lockfiles, unlocked
